RagShortTexts: Lake Phoetis lies within Imperial territory near the Imperial capital.
Lake Phoetis was a sacred site of the Palaic people.

Variants.Content: Lake Phoetis... seems to be a small lake inside the Empire, near the capital. I hear it's quite beautiful.

Lake Phoetis was once a sacred site of the Palaic people. Like the Battanians, the Palaics had a tradition of lake worship, offering sacrifices to holy spirits in the waters to pray for bountiful harvests and good fortune.
